start-here.title: Welcome to LeafCraft Plugin Support
start-here.description:
I maintain LeafRTP, OnePlayerSleep, TreeGen, and their shared server libraries here in my spare time. To keep answers searchable and stop questions from getting buried in a scrolling chat stream, all support lives in the **#support** Forum channel.

**House Rules**
1. **Use `#support` for all questions and bug reports.** Pick your project tag (`🌿 LeafRTP`, `💤 OnePlayerSleep`, `🌲 TreeGen`) and platform tag (`Paper / Spigot`, `Folia`, `Fabric`, `NeoForge`, `Velocity / Proxy`).
2. **Do not ping me in `#general` or DMs for support.** The forum bot checks every new thread against the documentation and `[RTP bit]` catalog right away, and pings me once a bug report has logs.
3. **Never paste raw passwords or `network.yml` secrets.** Use <https://mclo.gs/> for server logs; it strips IPs automatically.

start-here.title: LeafRTP 60-Second Quick Start
start-here.description:
One jar runs on Paper, Spigot (1.18+), Folia (1.21.11+), Fabric (1.20.1, 1.21 - 26.3), NeoForge (1.21.1+), and Velocity. Drop it in `plugins/` (or `mods/`), restart, and run `/rtp`.

- **Visual map editor:** Run `/rtp editor` to drag your region border on a live map of your world and review a YAML diff before saving (no open ports required).
- **Guided in-game wizard:** Run `/rtp admin setup` to pick single/multi-world topology, gameplay presets, and region radius with automatic config backups.
- **One-line radius change:** Run `/rtp config regions default shape.radius=10km shape.centerRadius=1km`.
- **Switch from another plugin:** Run `/rtp config import` to translate an existing BetterRTP, EzRTP, or JustRTP folder with a preview before writing.

start-here.title: How to Get Support & Claim @Pro Supporter
start-here.description:
- **Check the 5 pinned threads in `#support` first** - they cover region radius, toggling the `/rtp` GUI (`openOnBareRtp`), importing from BetterRTP/EzRTP, platform notes, and `/rtp test`.
- **Opening a `#support` post:** If the bot's cited doc answer solves your question, react with ✅ (or click **[✅ Solved]** / reply `solved`). If the doc does not cover your setup or you hit a bug, react with ❓ or reply with your `/rtp version`, `/version`, `/rtp test` output, and an <https://mclo.gs/> link so the bot can queue it for me.
- **LeafRTP Pro buyers (`BuiltByBit`):** Both editions run the same MIT code. Buying Pro on BuiltByBit funds development and grants the `@Pro Supporter` role via `#bbb-logs`. When you open a thread in `#support`, the bot attaches the `💎 Pro Priority` tag and routes your ticket to the front of my queue (24-72 h weekday target).

benchmarks.title: Measured Performance: Paper 26.2 & Folia 26.2
benchmarks.description:
Every number below comes from the open-source harness in `helpers/StressTestRTP/` running on the same host against a fresh world. Full CSVs and reproduction commands live in <https://dailystruggle.github.io/RTP/site/how-it-works/>.

**Paper 26.2 (598 teleports at 5/s across 2 runs, 48 bots online)**
- **Failed teleports / watchdog stalls:** `0 / 0`
- **Median `/rtp`-to-arrival latency:** `5 ms` (prepared queue hit)
- **Whole-server MSPT p95:** `21.2 - 21.3 ms` (`TPS >= 19.98`)
- **At 40 teleports/s sustained:** `MSPT p95 42.6 - 45.2 ms` (`TPS >= 19.19`), `0` stalls

**Folia 26.2 (regionalized threads, 1.21.11+ floor)**
- **Watchdog stalls / thread-ownership violations:** `0 / 0`
- **Execution model:** Count-bound task pipes on region threads with off-tick `.mca` / `.linear` region-file pre-filtering on the async pool.

benchmarks.title: Landing Spacing & Server Sizing Notes
benchmarks.description:
- **Spacing between players:** In two Paper 26.2 runs of 4,096 teleports each, `0` spots repeated, `0` pairs landed within 48 blocks, and the closest pair was `70 blocks` apart (compared to ~80 close pairs with plain random picks).
- **Heap headroom:** Prepared spots in the hot queue hold chunk tickets (`activeChunkCap: 10` by default) so arrival does not wait on disk I/O. When old-generation heap usage reaches `maxHeapPercent` (`85%` default in `advanced/performance.yml`), background refilling pauses and held tickets drop back to cold storage automatically.
- **Pregeneration caveat:** You do not need Chunky, but running `/rtp scan start` (or Chunky) ahead of time lets the `.mca` / `.linear` pre-filter read existing region files from disk instead of waiting on first-time chunk generation.

pinned_forum_threads.title: Read First: How to get fast help (and /rtp test)
pinned_forum_threads.body:
I maintain these projects solo, so `#support` is set up to get you an answer right away without waiting on time zones.

### 1. How `#support` works
- When you open a thread, the support bot checks your post (and any linked `mclo.gs` paste) against the operator docs, shipped YAML schemas, and the `[RTP bit]` fault catalog.
- If the cited command or YAML key solves your problem, react with ✅ (or click **[✅ Solved]** / reply `solved`) to close the thread.
- If the bot is unsure whether a doc covers your case, it will ask a couple of narrowing questions rather than guessing. Reply with those details (or react with ❓) and it will queue the thread in `#bot-triage-queue` for me.

### 2. Run the built-in self-test (`/rtp test`)
LeafRTP includes a non-destructive Built-In Test (BIT) suite that checks your YAML types, region references, world names, chunk tickets, and scheduler health in game:
```text
/rtp version
/rtp info
/rtp test
```
If startup or `/rtp reload` printed a line starting with `[RTP bit]` (for example `RTP-1301 RTP_REGION_UNKNOWN_WORLD` or `RTP-1401 RTP_SHAPE_RADIUS_NOT_ABOVE_CENTER`), paste that exact line in your thread - the bot will reply immediately with the fix.

### 3. The 4 items every bug report needs
1. Output of `/rtp version` and `/version`.
2. Output of `/rtp test` (or `/rtp info`).
3. Full `logs/latest.log` uploaded to <https://mclo.gs/> (no console screenshots; if the server crashes on startup before commands can run, the `mclo.gs` log + server version is enough).
4. One sentence on what you ran and what happened instead.

Full support policy and version windows: <https://dailystruggle.github.io/RTP/FOR_SERVER_ADMINS/>

pinned_forum_threads.title: Quick Fix: Setting Region Radius, Inner Spawn Hole & World Border
pinned_forum_threads.body:
By default, LeafRTP teleports players between `1,024 blocks` (`centerRadius: 64` chunks) and `4,096 blocks` (`radius: 256` chunks) from `(0, 0)`. You can change that in three ways.

### Option A: One-line command in game or console
```text
/rtp config regions default shape.radius=10km shape.centerRadius=1km --dry-run
/rtp config regions default shape.radius=10km shape.centerRadius=1km
```
Unit suffixes (`b` blocks, `c` chunks, `r` region files, `km` kilometers) work everywhere. A bare number without a suffix is read in **chunks** (`1 chunk = 16 blocks`).

### Option B: Browser map workspace or guided wizard
- Run `/rtp editor` to open your world map in the browser, drag the outer radius and inner donut hole directly on the map, and apply the diff.
- Or run `/rtp admin setup` to step through world layout and radius presets in game.

### Option C: Edit YAML directly
- **Single-world servers:** edit `defaults.shape.radius` and `defaults.shape.centerRadius` in `plugins/RTP/config.yml` (on Fabric / NeoForge: `config/rtp/config.yml`). Every region with `shape: "@config"` inherits those values.
- **Per-region override:** replace `shape: "@config"` in `definitions/regions/default.yml` with an inline block:
```yaml
shape:
  name: "CIRCLE"
  mode: "REROLL"
  radius: 10000b
  centerRadius: 1000b
  centerX: 0
  centerZ: 0
```
- **Follow vanilla `/worldborder`:** set `worldBorderOverride: true` in `definitions/regions/default.yml`.

**Caveat:** `shape.radius` must always be strictly larger than `shape.centerRadius` (`RTP_SHAPE_RADIUS_NOT_ABOVE_CENTER`). After changing your region bounds, run `/rtp reload` and `/rtp scan start`.

Docs: <https://dailystruggle.github.io/RTP/admin/QUICK_START/#step-4-adjust-the-teleport-area>

pinned_forum_threads.title: Quick Fix: Toggling Bare /rtp GUI vs. Instant Teleport (openOnBareRtp)
pinned_forum_threads.body:
Out of the box, LeafRTP ships with `LeafRTPGuiAddon` enabled so typing bare `/rtp` opens a chest-style destination picker.

### Make bare `/rtp` teleport immediately (keep `/rtp gui` working)
Edit `plugins/RTP/addons/guimenu.yml` (`config/rtp/addons/guimenu.yml` on Fabric / NeoForge) and set:
```yaml
openOnBareRtp: false
```
Then run `/rtp reload`. You can also toggle this during `/rtp admin setup`.
- With `openOnBareRtp: false`, typing `/rtp` teleports the player right away in their current world.
- Players can still open the destination picker explicitly with `/rtp gui` (permission `rtp.gui`).

### Remove the GUI addon completely
Delete `LeafRTPGuiAddon-*.jar` from `plugins/RTP/addons/` and restart the server.

**Caveat:** Delete the `.jar` file inside `plugins/RTP/addons/`, **not** the `addons/` folder itself. If you delete the whole `addons/` folder, LeafRTP treats the next boot as a fresh install and unpacks the bundled addon jars again.

Docs: <https://dailystruggle.github.io/RTP/admin/ADDONS/#the-bundled-gui-demo>

pinned_forum_threads.title: Quick Fix: 1-Command Migration from BetterRTP, EzRTP, or JustRTP (/rtp config import)
pinned_forum_threads.body:
You do not need to rewrite your worlds, radii, cooldowns, or economy prices by hand when switching from another random teleport plugin.

### 1. Preview the import (safe dry-run)
Keep your old plugin's config folder in `plugins/` (for example `plugins/BetterRTP/`, `plugins/EzRTP/`, `plugins/justRTP/`, or `plugins/JakesRTP/`). The old plugin jar does **not** need to be running. Run:
```text
/rtp config import
```
This scans `plugins/` and prints every region, world, cooldown, price, database setting, and effect it will create without overwriting existing files.

### 2. Apply the import
```text
/rtp config import overwrite=true
```
Or target a specific plugin folder:
```text
/rtp config import betterrtp overwrite=true
/rtp config import ezrtp overwrite=true
/rtp config import justrtp overwrite=true
```

### 3. Migrate player permissions (LuckPerms)
```text
/rtp config import permissions
/rtp config import permissions apply=true
```
**Note on permissions:** Unlike BetterRTP (which requires `betterrtp.world.<world>` alongside `betterrtp.use`), LeafRTP ships with `requirePermission: false` on world and region files, so `rtp.use` alone lets players `/rtp` in any configured world.

Docs: <https://dailystruggle.github.io/RTP/admin/MIGRATION/>

pinned_forum_threads.title: Folia, Fabric & NeoForge Platform Guide
pinned_forum_threads.body:
One `LeafRTP-<version>.jar` runs across Paper, Spigot, Folia, Fabric, NeoForge, and Velocity. Here are the platform-specific details and caveats.

### Folia (`1.21.11+` only)
- **Floor:** Folia is supported on **Minecraft 1.21.11 and newer**. Folia is an experimental upstream fork that only maintains its current releases; older Folia builds (such as 1.20.4 or 1.21.4) crash on their own at boot and are unsupported.
- **Threading:** All background queue work runs on count-bound task pipes (`ADR-004`) inside regional schedulers, and economy calls are isolated off region threads (`F-003`).

### Fabric (`1.20.1` and `1.21 - 26.3`) & NeoForge (`1.21.1+`)
- **Install path:** Drop the same `LeafRTP-<version>.jar` into `mods/` (not `plugins/`).
- **Config path:** Files unpack to `config/rtp/` instead of `plugins/RTP/`.
- **Unsupported gap:** Fabric `1.20.2 - 1.20.6` is not supported due to upstream chunk-future and item API breaks in those minor versions. Legacy Forge (`<= 1.20.1`) has no native adapter; run the jar under Arclight or Mohist if you are on legacy Forge.

### Velocity / Multi-Server Proxy Mode
- Configure `advanced/network.yml` (`network.enabled: true`, unique `network.serverId`) and set `RTP_NET_SECRET` in your environment. Never paste your `network.yml` secret or Redis password into a public thread.

Full matrix: <https://dailystruggle.github.io/RTP/dev/SUPPORT_MATRIX/>
